title: Magic Kingdom Deep Cuts
intro: [excited] Welcome back to Magic Kingdom, but tonight we're skipping the obvious stuff. [whispers] We're going deep. Tunnels, secret suites, trains from Mexico... [laughs] Only true park nerds survive this one.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A fairy-tale castle at night seen from a hidden angle behind colonial rooftops, glowing lanterns hung in an old oak tree, a vintage steam locomotive puffing past, and a secret lit window high in a tower.

categories.title: Now a Major Motion Picture
categories.intro: Our film category is all about movies that started life as Magic Kingdom attractions. [chuckles] The ride came first. Then Hollywood came knocking.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A vintage movie theatre marquee with empty lightbulb borders next to a jungle riverboat, a spooky mansion gate and a retro rocket, film reels spilling across a red carpet.

clues.clue: Dwayne Johnson plays riverboat skipper Frank in this 2021 movie based on a classic Adventureland boat ride.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Jungle Cruise! [laughs] And yes, the movie has puns almost as bad as the real skippers'. Almost.

clues.clue: Eddie Murphy starred in a 2003 movie based on this spooky Liberty Square ride.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is The Haunted Mansion! [whispers] It got another movie in 2023. 999 happy haunts, and room for one more sequel.

clues.clue: George Clooney starred in this 2015 movie named after an entire Magic Kingdom land.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Tomorrowland! [excited] Its opening even features the song from Walt's Carousel of Progress. A great big beautiful Easter egg.

clues.clue: Frontierland's banjo-strumming bear band got their own live-action movie in 2002, called this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is The Country Bears! [laughs] Big Al got a movie before most princes did. Let that sink in.

clues.clue: Brian De Palma's 2000 sci-fi film shares its name with this Tomorrowland ride that closed in 1993.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mission to Mars! [gasps] The ride closed in October 1993, and its show building later became Alien Encounter and then Stitch's Great Escape.

categories.title: Hidden in Plain Sight
categories.intro: Next, Hidden in Plain Sight! [whispers] These are the secrets you've walked right past a hundred times.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A detective's magnifying glass over a cobblestone colonial street, a tiny three-circle shape hidden in the pattern of a stained-glass window, a doorway to an underground tunnel half open.

clues.clue: Fans hunt all over the parks for these secret three-circle shapes tucked into designs and decorations.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Hidden Mickeys! [excited] Once you start spotting them, you can never stop. Sorry in advance.

clues.clue: Liberty Square's Liberty Tree is hung with 13 lanterns representing these.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the 13 original colonies! [chuckles] It's a nod to the real Liberty Tree in Boston, where the Sons of Liberty met.

clues.clue: Magic Kingdom sits on top of a network of tunnels that cast members use to move around unseen. They're called these.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is utilidors! [whispers] Fun fact: Magic Kingdom is actually on the second floor. The tunnels are the ground floor.

clues.clue: In Liberty Square, a brownish strip down the middle of the walkway represents this, like streets in colonial times.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is sewage! [laughs] Colonial streets had open gutters. That's also why there are no restrooms in Liberty Square. Enjoy your churro!

clues.clue: This Imagineer designed the five Cinderella Castle mosaics, made from more than 300,000 pieces of glass.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Dorothea Redmond! [excited] Mary Blair was a great guess, but Redmond drew the designs, and a team of artists spent nearly two years setting the tiles.

categories.title: Snap Judgment
categories.intro: Time for Snap Judgment! These are real photos of Magic Kingdom spots that aren't quite on the postcards. [chuckles] Name what you see.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A stack of vintage instant photos clipped to a string with tiny clothespins, showing glimpses of a treehouse, a colonial bell and a riverside mill, warm theme park sunset behind.

clues.clue: This replica of a famous American artifact sits in Magic Kingdom's Liberty Square. What is it?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Liberty Bell! [laughs] Crack included. Disney doesn't miss a detail.

clues.clue: Name the Magic Kingdom show that takes place in this theater.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is The Hall of Presidents! [excited] Every U.S. president is on stage as an Audio-Animatronic figure. Very dignified. Very still.

clues.clue: Name this Adventureland show, where hundreds of birds, flowers and tiki poles sing.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Enchanted Tiki Room! [laughs] In the tiki tiki tiki tiki tiki room... and now it's stuck in your head. You're welcome.

clues.clue: This giant tree is home to which Adventureland attraction, based on a 1960 Disney film?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Swiss Family Treehouse! [excited] The tree is fake, but it has hundreds of thousands of fake leaves. Somebody counted. Not me.

clues.clue: Harper's Mill, seen here, stood on which Magic Kingdom attraction until it closed in 2025?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Tom Sawyer Island! [sighs] You could only get there by raft. It closed in July 2025 to make way for new Cars-themed adventures.

categories.title: Tomorrowland Time Machine
categories.intro: Our parks category is Tomorrowland Time Machine! [excited] The future, as imagined in the past, explained in the present. My brain hurts.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A retro-futuristic city of spinning rocket ships and glowing neon rings at dusk, a rotating theater building, a sleek light-cycle racing under a glowing canopy.

clues.clue: At this Tomorrowland attraction, even little kids can steer a gas-powered car around a track.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Tomorrowland Speedway! [laughs] The cars are on a guide rail, so mom, please stop pretending you're in the Daytona 500.

clues.clue: On Buzz Lightyear's Space Ranger Spin, guests zap targets to defeat this evil emperor.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Emperor Zurg! [dramatic] Also Buzz's dad in Toy Story 2. Family therapy needed.

clues.clue: This Sherman Brothers song plays as the Carousel of Progress theater rotates.
clues.answer: There's a Great Big Beautiful Tomorrow
accept: there's a great big beautiful tomorrow
choices: There's a Great Big Beautiful Tomorrow
clues.reveal: The correct answer is There's a Great Big Beautiful Tomorrow! [excited] Shining at the end of every day. It's Walt's favorite kind of optimism.

clues.clue: Walt Disney's Carousel of Progress debuted at this event in 1964.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the New York World's Fair! [chuckles] It's often called the longest-running stage show in American theater history. Take that, Broadway.

clues.clue: Tomorrowland's coaster TRON Lightcycle / Run opened at Magic Kingdom in this year.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is 2023! [excited] It debuted in Shanghai first, then raced its way to Florida. Lean forward, user!

categories.title: Main Street Fine Print
categories.intro: Our fan category is Main Street Fine Print! [mischievously] Let's see who actually stops to look around instead of sprinting to the rides.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A turn-of-the-century small town main street at night, horse-drawn streetcar tracks, a barbershop quartet's straw hats on a bench, a hot dog cart and a vintage steam locomotive at a Victorian station.

clues.clue: On Main Street, U.S.A., you can ride a streetcar pulled by one of these animals.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a horse! [laughs] Big, gentle draft horses. They even get the summer off on the hottest days.

clues.clue: Casey's Corner, named after a famous baseball poem, is best known for this ballpark food.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is hot dogs! [excited] Named for 'Casey at the Bat.' Mighty Casey struck out, but the chili cheese dog never does.

clues.clue: The secret suite inside Cinderella Castle was originally planned for this group.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Disney family! [sighs] Walt died before the park opened, so the space sat unfinished for decades before becoming the Cinderella Castle Suite.

clues.clue: This barbershop quartet in straw boater hats sings on Main Street, U.S.A.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Dapper Dans! [chuckles] Four-part harmony, zero microphones and some seriously impressive mustaches.

clues.clue: The steam locomotives on the Walt Disney World Railroad were found in a train boneyard in this country and restored.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mexico! [gasps] Imagineers found them on the Yucatan peninsula and rebuilt them for the park's 1971 opening. All aboard!
